emails.subject_line_b: Upfront DFW roof calculator for Dennis
emails.body_text:
Hey Dennis,

I was looking through honestroof.com and really respected your upfront pricing-by-the-square message — not many DFW roofers lead with straight talk.

One leak caught my eye: mobile visitors still hit a 9-field address form with no instant ballpark range before submitting.

So I built a working 30-second DFW Roof Estimator in your crimson-and-slate HonestRoof.com branding. Homeowners tap their size, slope, and Class 4 shingle or metal choice and see an honest local ballpark before entering their name and phone.

Mind if I send over the live preview link?

— {{sender_name}}

{{sender_address}} | {{unsubscribe_line}}

objection_handlers.objection: We already publish honest upfront pricing by the square — why add a calculator?
objection_handlers.reframe_response: Most DFW homeowners don't know what a roofing 'square' is or how 2-story steep pitch affects their total. This translates your honest per-square philosophy into an instant 30-second total and monthly range on their phone, so they book with full trust instead of bouncing off a 9-field form.

objection_handlers.objection: Online roof estimates can't replace seeing the decking and flashing in person.
objection_handlers.reframe_response: 100% agree — this never gives a binding bid. It gives an honest DFW ballpark range with an on-site inspection disclaimer so $6,000 tire-kickers filter themselves out while qualified homeowners book knowing a real North Texas replacement runs $13k–$40k+.

objection_handlers.objection: Why pay $750 setup + $149/mo when we already have a contact form?
objection_handlers.reframe_response: Your 9-field address form leaks mobile visitors who want a ballpark first. This widget lifts conversions right on your homepage, tags North Texas hail/leak urgency automatically, gets quarterly DFW pricing updates, and a single extra closed roof covers 3+ years.

objection_handlers.objection: I don't want anyone breaking honestroof.com or slowing it down.
objection_handlers.reframe_response: Zero redesign required. It's a 28 KB vanilla JS script inside Shadow DOM isolation, so it cannot touch a single style on your site or slow down your page — and we'll hand your web person the fix for your render-blocking header script for free.

objection_handlers.objection: Send me the numbers and I'll look it over with my team.
objection_handlers.reframe_response: Happy to — I'll send a short 3-bullet recap ($750 one-time DFW calibration & setup, $149/mo hosting, instant SMS/email routing, and quarterly pricing updates, cancel anytime) plus the live link to tap through on your phone. Good to check back Thursday morning?
